# Phase Three — Final Safeguards Before Sitewide Execution

The Awtsmoos is beyond the ledger yet gives the ledger truth; Awtsmoos.com must survive the skeptical user, maintainer, tester, and future youth.

## Additional Safeguards

1. Verify every counted route is actually navigable.
2. Preserve canonical URL semantics and trailing-slash behavior.
3. Check redirects separately from load failures.
4. Detect HTML served for missing JS/CSS as MIME/catch-all defects.
5. Distinguish auth-required from broken unauthenticated pages.
6. Record browser viewport/device scale used for each layout check.
7. Check scroll height and fixed overlays on short screens.
8. Check touch target size for primary actions.
9. Check focus visibility after any outline customization.
10. Check logical focus order after DOM rearrangement.
11. Check native form submit/Enter behavior.
12. Check back/forward/reload state for search/social flows.
13. Check reduced motion when animated pages claim motion.
14. Check high-content/long-title resilience.
15. Check Hebrew/RTL content where relevant without forcing global RTL.
16. Check empty/loading/error/success/disabled/selected states.
17. Check offline/network-failure behavior where realistic.
18. Check local-storage/history corruption tolerance where used.
19. Check game pause/restart after focus loss.
20. Check editor resize and canvas DPR behavior.
21. Check media autoplay policy assumptions.
22. Check route indexes do not advertise dead experiences as complete.
23. Check broken external links separately from local runtime.
24. Check source maps/debug assets do not block production.
25. Check large images/video do not become critical-path resources without need.
26. Check font loading does not cause avoidable invisible text.
27. Check compact output syntax and MIME for ES modules.
28. Check compact transform cache key includes relevant query/version inputs.
29. Check noncompact fallback remains functional.
30. Check cold-start server transform cost.
31. Check route-level CSS duplication before any consolidation decision.
32. Check shared component changes against multiple representative routes.
33. Check each new module has one real responsibility.
34. Check every changed import path actually resolves on case-sensitive filesystems.
35. Check line endings/encoding preserve Hebrew text correctly.
36. Check tests fail for the regression they claim to protect.
37. Check no test was weakened merely to achieve green.
38. Check full Git snapshot for secrets before staging/push.
39. Check oversized binaries/generated artifacts before publication.
40. Check upstream divergence after fetch.
41. Check deployment uses the pushed commit.
42. Check production normal-cache and cache-busted behavior.
43. Check production error logs/health where available.
44. Check representative routes after deploy, not only the edited one.
45. Reopen the remaining-work ledger after every success; success creates shadow work.

## NEXT_ACTION

Write the final execution tranche, then harvest every currently running discovery/verification receipt and execute the first safe ranked route family.
